lesson_title: From the Sun to the Compost Heap
hook_text: Your lunch started 150 million kilometres away. Can you follow it all the way back to the soil?
clip_script: A school garden in George. Sunlight hits the spinach, and photosynthesis makes glucose. Extra food is stored as starch in maize and beans. In the kitchen: carbohydrates, proteins, a little oil, and vitamins from the veggies. A balanced plate! After lunch, the peels go on the compost. Fungi, bacteria and worms break them down, and the nutrients go back to the soil. Term 1, done!
visual_style: Whiteboard loop from the Sun to a leaf, to a plate divided into food groups, to a compost heap and back to the soil.
mood: Satisfying and complete, like finishing a good meal.
pacing: Three stops: garden, kitchen, compost heap.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and trace the energy in your own lunch.
